name: Traffic Safety Committee Meeting
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  October 12, 2011
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  4:00 PM

Upon request, the agenda can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a
disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at
378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or
accommodation.

The decisions of the Traffic Safety Committee are advisory to the City Council, and the City
Council will take formal action to approve or deny said decisions at their meeting on Tuesday,
October 25, 2011. Interested persons who wish to object to the decision may speak to the Council
with their concerns. As these decisions are typically on the Consent Calendar, the person must ask
the Council during the appropriate time at the beginning of the meeting to “pull” the item from the
Consent Calendar for discussion.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

CEREMONIAL MATTERS – Swearing-in of New Committee Member David King

ROLL CALL

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that are not
otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Traffic Safety
Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda
unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action
arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

OLD BUSINESS
1. Request for Left-Turn Restriction on Via Anita at the 100 Block of Palos Verdes Drive West

2. Request to Modify the PVHS RPZ Turn-Restriction Signs from a 7:00 am - 9:00 am Time
  Period to a 6:30 am – 9:00 am Time Period

NEW BUSINESS
3. None.

RESIDENT LETTERS
4. None.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on October 25, 2011.
 ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM STAFF/COMMITTEE
5. City Council Items of Information for the Committee

MINUTES
6. Meeting of September 14, 2011

ADJOURNMENT TO NOVEMBER 9, 2011

  Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative
  formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City
Clerk at 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on October 25, 2011.
minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO
  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  October 12, 2011
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  4:00 PM

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

CEREMONIAL MATTERS – New Committee Member David King Sworn in by Deputy City Clerk

ROLL CALL  Committee Members King, Kao, Beall, and Vice-Chair Buss present. Chairman
  Friedman absent.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

OLD BUSINESS
1. Request for Left-Turn Restriction on Via Anita at the 100 Block of Palos Verdes Drive West

  Action: Recommended that staff 1) implement Alternative 1, the installation of W2-1
  crossing signage on Palos Verdes Drive West and Palos Verdes Blvd in Torrance prior to the
  intersection and 2) implement a restricted left turn from Via Anita to Palos Verdes Drive
  West between 7 – 9 am and 4 – 6 pm, Mon - Fri. (Approved 4-0, Chairman Friedman absent)

  The Committee additionally requested that staff bring back to a future meeting more
  information on Alternative 4, installation of a roundabout at the Via Rosa/Via Anita/Palos
  Verdes Drive West intersection.

2. Request to Modify the PVHS RPZ Turn Restriction Signs from a 7:00 am - 9:00 am Time
  Period to a 6:30 am – 9:00 am Time Period

  Action: Recommended that staff 1) modify six PVHS RPZ turn restriction signs to show a
  6:30 am – 9:00 am time period. (Approved 4-0, Chairman Friedman absent)

NEW BUSINESS
3. None.

RESIDENT LETTERS
4. None.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM STAFF/COMMITTEE
5. City Council Items of Information for the Committee.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on Tuesday, October 25, 2011.
 MINUTES
6. Meeting of September 14, 2011

  Action: (Approved 3-0, King abstaining, Chairman Friedman absent)

ADJOURNMENT TO NOVEMBER 9, 2011.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on Tuesday, October 25, 2011.
